FeatureAccess: Share a whole room or a single file through a link, and set who can view, comment, or edit.
FeatureMemberRole: Each room gives you a role that decides whether you can view, comment, edit, or upload.
FeatureMemberWork: Open a document straight from the room and edit it with everyone else in real time.
FeatureMembers: Add people to a room and give each one a role that decides what they can do with the files.
FeatureRoomSecurity: Block downloads and copying, add a watermark, and set links to expire when the work is done.
FeatureTypes: Pick a room type that matches the job: everyday teamwork, public sharing, or a locked-down data room.
FeatureTypesTitle: A room type for every task
RoomsArchive: Finished with a room? Archive it instead of deleting: it leaves the active list but keeps every file and comment.
RoomsArchiveRestore: Archived rooms are read-only — unarchive one to start working in it again.
RoomsColumns: Click the gear to choose the columns you care about — room type, tags, owner, or the date of the last activity.
RoomsInfoPanel: The info panel is where you run a room: who is in it and how they got in.
RoomsInfoPanelHistory: The history shows who joined, uploaded, or changed something, and when.
RoomsInfoPanelLinks: Create an access link with the rights you need, and set it to expire.
RoomsInfoPanelMember: The info panel tells you who else is in the room and what has been happening in it.
RoomsInfoPanelMemberRoles: See every member and the role they hold, so you know who to ask for a change.
RoomsInfoPanelMembers: Invite members and change a person's role without leaving the list.
RoomsQuickAccess: Recent keeps the rooms you opened lately at the top, so you don't scroll for them.
RoomsQuickAccessFavorites: Star a room and it stays in Favorites, right above.
RoomsSearch: Find a room by name — results update as you type.
RoomsSearchScope: Search looks through the rooms you have access to, not the files inside them.
RoomsTrash: Deleted rooms land in Trash, so a wrong click is not the end. Restore one from there, or empty Trash to free up space.
TourCreate: Rooms differ by what members are allowed to do, so start by picking the type that fits your task.
TourCreateCollaboration: Collaboration — a team edits the same files together.
TourCreateCustom: Custom — set the rules yourself when the ready-made types don't fit.
TourCreatePublic: Public — share files by link with people who have no account.
TourFilter: Filters narrow the list down when the name alone is not enough.
TourFilterTags: Tag your rooms by project or client, then filter by a tag to see just those.
TourRoomItem: Every row is a room you can act on without opening it.
TourRoomItemContextMenu: The three dots open all actions: invite people, copy the shared link, edit the room, archive it.
TourRoomItemMemberMenu: The three dots open what is available to you: copy a link to the room, or leave it.
TourRoomItemOpen: Click the name to go inside and work with the files.
TourRoomItemPin: Pin the rooms you use daily and they stay at the top of the list.
TourRooms: A room is a shared space, not just a folder.
TourRoomsMember: A room is a shared space someone invited you into, not just a folder.
TourRoomsMemberRole: The role you were given in a room decides what you can do there — view, comment, edit, or upload.
TourRoomsMemberScope: You only see the rooms you belong to; ask their owner if you need access to another one.
TourRoomsMembers: You invite members and give each a role, so everyone sees exactly what they should.
TourRoomsPersonal: Files you keep to yourself belong in your personal section instead.
TourTemplates: Setting up the same room again and again? Save it as a template.
TourTemplatesReuse: Create a new room from a template in one click — nothing to configure twice.
TourTemplatesSave: A template keeps the room's structure, tags, logo, and access settings.
TourVdr: A virtual data room is for files that must not leak — due diligence, contracts, audits.
TourVdrRestrictions: Block downloading, printing, and copying, so files stay inside the room.
TourVdrWatermark: Stamp every document with a watermark that names the person viewing it.
